_metadata.description: Credential provisioning and readiness: descriptor-complete guidance, a disclosure-free relay boundary, backend diagnosis, and recovery coverage.

requirements.title: The wizard shall let an operator provision every declared credential without the value crossing any boundary other than the credential authority.
requirements.description: Compositional claim for the credential domain. The relay boundary is correct today; the guidance half and the negative disclosure assertions are outstanding.

validation.notes: Relay half proven; disclosure and guidance halves covered by companion evidence.

requirements.title: When a credential value is submitted, the API shall relay it to the credential authority and shall return only the logical identity and field.
requirements.description: The value is accepted only in a request body, forwarded to the authority client, and never placed in a command argument, a response, or operator state.

validation.notes: Asserts the response body carries no value and a rejected authority yields a service-unavailable state.

requirements.title: If a credential value is submitted, then no response body, log line, request URL, operator-state field, or browser store shall contain that value.
requirements.description: The implementation is correct by construction, but only the response-body half is asserted. The target adds explicit negative assertions across every egress the value could reach, so a later refactor that starts logging the request body fails a test.

validation.notes: Evidence: captures logs, the request line, and the written operator-state document, and asserts none contains the submitted value.

requirements.title: Each credential card shall present the descriptor's declared purpose and its obtain link.
requirements.description: The shared credential descriptor declares description ('why this credential is needed and what it unlocks') and obtain_url ('where an operator signs up') specifically for onboarding. The readiness projection drops both, so the operator sees a required password field with no explanation and no link.

validation.notes: Evidence: the readiness projection carries description and obtain_url through from the descriptor.

Evidence target: `ui/src/components/wizard/StepCredentials.test.tsx`; this requirement remains planned until that evidence is added. the card renders the purpose text and an obtain link pointing at the declared URL.

requirements.title: If the credential backend is unreachable, then the readiness report shall name the backend condition and the next action.
requirements.description: An unset value, an unreachable secure store, and a host with no backend each have a different fix. The report distinguishes them rather than collapsing them into one failure.

validation.notes: Asserts an unreachable authority yields an unsupported status with diagnosis text rather than an unconfigured status.

requirements.title: The readiness report should name every configured credential that the verified recovery bundle does not cover.
requirements.description: A credential nothing declares is a credential no backup captures. The report treats an uncovered configured credential as a durable risk, not as a passing state.

validation.notes: Asserts the recovery block reports uncovered entries and an absent receipt.

requirements.title: While the host has no graphical session, the wizard shall direct the operator to initialize the encrypted file store before provisioning.
requirements.description: Every native store needs a logged-in desktop session, so a VPS, a CI runner, or a headless bundle host has none. This is the default condition for remote onboarding, not an edge case, and the wizard must lead with the fix rather than report a failure.

validation.notes: Evidence: a no-session backend yields the store-init remediation rather than a generic unsupported state.
